title: Vulnerable BEARER executor — pending expected-fail marker, not a runnable subject
honesty: This file is a MARKER, not a vector and not a subject. It records a deliberately-weak executor shape — a BEARER grant with NO state_nonce and NO executor attestation — that CREDENTIAL_BOUNDARY and ATOMIC_COMMIT WOULD have to fail against, once those profiles can assert anything. Today they cannot: both are why_empty in lib/assurance-profiles.js, VECTOR_MAP carries no vectors for either id, and every shipped subject is a pure function of case input with no host and no executor. A runnable fake host or fake executor scored green here would imply this suite covers raw-host bypass and atomic commit when it does not. That is the green-on-vulnerable suite this marker exists to refuse. Until the missing surfaces land, a pass against this fixture would be vacuous, and a fail would be invented. Recorded, not executed.

intended_subject.measured_from: node_modules/@coderifts/agent-guard/dist/cjs/with-coderifts.js (RESIDUAL_GRANT_BEARER_NO_STATE_NONCE; ENFORCING_STRICT permits BEARER and names it; executorAttestation is not required at construction)

intended_bite.why: CREDENTIAL_BOUNDARY and ATOMIC_COMMIT are NOT_COVERED (no vectors). --assurance on either id exits 3 for every subject, including reference. There is no vulnerable subject to FAIL, and reference does not PASS those profiles — both are unproved. Exit 3 is 'nothing proved this', not 'this was disproved' (bin/coderifts-conformance.js:86-107).

what_is_missing_to_assert: A RUNNING host with a tool table (every subject here is a pure function of case input with no host).

A vector that attempts a raw tool beside the guarded table — recorded today as excluded vector raw_tool_beside_guarded_table in fixtures/adversarial.v1.json, covered_by @coderifts/bypass-probe against the adopter's own installation.
Wiring a fake host would score a fake host: a passing fake would imply this suite covers raw-host bypass when it does not, weakening bypass-probe rather than adding to it.
An executor this suite does not run, that consumes a nonce once as part of the same transaction as the mutation.

A stateful public verifier — receipt-verifier is STATELESS and cannot detect a replayed jti by construction, so a vector asserting 'replay is rejected' would assert a control the public code does not implement.
Issuance of overlapping grants (concurrent_grants) — @coderifts/agent-guard still exports no issueExecutionGrant (re-measured; tryIssue* are attestations, not grants).

Executor attestation as cas_evidence.class === 'executor_attested' (cas-attestation.js:276-280, ENFORCING_ATOMIC). Absent attestation is host_claimed or absent, which ATOMIC refuses as authorized_and_committed.
The executable home today is @coderifts/agent-guard test/atomic-profile.test.js, not this repository.

trap.note: A BEARER grant document with no state_nonce is a GRANT SHAPE. EG-A-STATE-NONCE-MISMATCH already names a nonce and is counted under RECEIPT_CRYPTO (runner: none), not ATOMIC_COMMIT. Adding a grant-shaped fixture here would populate the wrong profile and still would not run: shipped subjects implement only decide and tool_selection.
